tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: warm cream, like the inside of a toy box.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, speech bubbles, box labels, the phone screen.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Soft card outlines and the chunky bottom edge of light buttons. Decoration only: never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All main text and the outline of every illustration. 14.9:1 on paper, 15.7:1 on card, 13.3:1 on sky-soft.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Second-level text (box numbers, 'Last checked'), and the border of an Off switch. 7.0:1 on paper, 7.4:1 on card, 6.3:1 on sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The Safety Shield and the one main button per screen. As text: links and selected menu items on paper or card (5.7:1). Focus ring.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: The chunky bottom edge of sky buttons; text on sky-soft (7.2:1).

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Shield glow, selected tiles, the 'Testing' state background.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sky (6.0:1) and danger (6.3:1) fills.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Buddy's helmet, stars, highlights. Ink text on it (10.1:1); never text in sun on light grounds.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Warm panels and the child's speech bubble. Ink text on it (14.2:1).

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Buddy's fur. Illustration only.

tokens.name: honey-soft
tokens.usage: Buddy's muzzle, belly and paw pads. Illustration only.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Rosy cheeks on Buddy, toys and people. Illustration only.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Shipping-box cardboard. Ink text on it (7.5:1); labels go on a card sticker.

tokens.name: kraft-deep
tokens.usage: Box flaps and fold shadows. Illustration only.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Packing tape across box tops. Illustration only.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Fill for 'Safe', grade A and the green tile. Ink text and icons on it (7.9:1). 3.2:1 lighter than danger, so the two never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: safe-ink
tokens.usage: The word 'Safe' on card (6.6:1) and safe-soft (5.7:1).

tokens.name: safe-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Safe tag and safe answers.

tokens.name: careful
tokens.usage: Fill for 'Careful' and grade C. Ink text and icons on it (8.8:1).

tokens.name: careful-ink
tokens.usage: The word 'Careful' on card (7.1:1) and careful-soft (6.2:1).

tokens.name: careful-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Careful tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill for 'Not safe' and grade F, with on-fill text (6.3:1). As text: 'Not safe' on card (6.3:1) and danger-soft (5.2:1).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Not safe tag and crossed-out answers.

tokens.name: grade-b
tokens.usage: Grade B sticker. Ink text on it (9.4:1).

tokens.name: grade-d
tokens.usage: Grade D sticker and the 'Without shield' bar. Ink text on it (6.3:1).

tokens.name: toy-pink
tokens.usage: Cuddle Bear (made-up toy). Illustration only.

tokens.name: toy-steel
tokens.usage: Robo Pal (made-up toy). Illustration only.

tokens.name: toy-mint
tokens.usage: Dino Chat (made-up toy) and the mint scarf. Illustration only.

tokens.name: toy-peach
tokens.usage: Bunny Buds (made-up toy). Illustration only.

tokens.name: toy-lilac
tokens.usage: Shirts and fabric in family pictures. Illustration only.

tokens.name: skin-1
tokens.usage: Skin tone, lightest. Use a mix of all five in every family picture.

tokens.name: skin-2
tokens.usage: Skin tone.

tokens.name: skin-3
tokens.usage: Skin tone.

tokens.name: skin-4
tokens.usage: Skin tone.

tokens.name: skin-5
tokens.usage: Skin tone, deepest.

tokens.name: hair-dark
tokens.usage: Hair, nearly black.

tokens.name: hair-brown
tokens.usage: Hair, brown.

tokens.name: hair-grey
tokens.usage: Hair, grey (grandparents).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Baloo 2 from Google Fonts: round, chunky, friendly.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per screen, the big question. On phones use size token text-hero-phone.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles. On phones use size token text-title-phone.

styles.name: grade-letter
styles.usage: The letter on a grade sticker (scaled by the sticker size).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Nunito from Google Fonts. Nothing smaller than 18px.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Speech bubbles and the one sentence that matters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The smallest text allowed: tags, box numbers, captions.

spacing.note: 8px steps, generous: lots of white space.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps inside icons and tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-word gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside tags and small tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; between rows in a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Laptop side gutter; above and below the main button.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between big screen sections on laptop.

radius.note: Everything is rounded like a toy block. No sharp corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Test tiles, inputs, box labels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and speech bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Big panels, the phone frame, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, switches, progress bars, stickers.

shadow.note: Soft and low, plus a chunky bottom edge on buttons so they look pressable.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, sheets, the phone frame.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: The chunky edge under a sky button; drops to 0 when pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-button-light
tokens.usage: The chunky edge under a white (secondary) button.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Grade stickers and status stamps.

tokens.name: glow-shield
tokens.usage: Anything the Safety Shield is protecting.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 4px paper gap, then 4px of solid sky (5.7:1 on paper). Follows the radius.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest anything you can tap.

tokens.name: tap-big
tokens.usage: Height of the one main button.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons beside words.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Picture icons on tiles and steps.

tokens.name: sticker-sm
tokens.usage: Grade sticker on a box or in a list.

tokens.name: sticker-md
tokens.usage: Grade sticker beside a heading.

tokens.name: sticker-lg
tokens.usage: The huge grade sticker on a report card or parent page.

tokens.name: text-hero-phone
tokens.usage: Hero font size below 640px wide.

tokens.name: text-title-phone
tokens.usage: Title font size below 640px wide.
